excerpt: The circular orbit of the synchrotron ... is 842.9 feet in diameter (about one-half mile in circumference). ... AGS DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS: MAGNET: Mean radius 421.5 ft. Sectors, number 240. ... Construction of the AGS, which includes 240 magnets placed in a ring-shaped 18 foot square tunnel one-half mile in circumference, was started in late 1955.
title: The Bulletin Board, Vol. 13 No. 48 — "Brookhaven's AGS Begins Operation" (BNL Personnel Office, 1960-08-02)
